title: Hypothetical nuclear-principle electromagnetic power source whose load can't be controlled

tellings.quote: >> hypothetically, if you have an electromagnetic power source that probably operates off of nuclear principles and it gives off energy and you can't control the load,

plain: Dylan Borland, a former US intelligence specialist who went public with UFO claims, puts a hypothetical to Michels: imagine an electromagnetic power source that probably runs on nuclear principles and gives off energy, and whose load cannot be controlled. He frames it as 'hypothetically', and names people he calls Towns and Brown. If such a device exists, it would be dangerous to anyone near it.
